data.gender_notes: Prateik is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Prateik means 'gifted', 'unique', 'distinct'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'prasanna' which means 'pleased' or 'gratified'. This name is given to a child who is believed to be a special and unique gift from the gods. The name Prateik carries the meaning “Gifted” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Prateik usually hope their child will grow to embody gifted and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Prateik belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gifted.”
